description: This file contains a JavaScript class 'ProductListing' that manages product filtering, searching, and restoring filter state on a product listing page, including event bindings and AJAX calls to fetch filtered product data.

classes.name: ProductListing
classes.description: A class that manages product filtering, search, and state restoration for a product listing webpage.

methods.name: bind_filters
methods.description: Binds change events to filter inputs and updates product list based on selected filters.

methods.name: make_filters
methods.description: Placeholder method for creating filters, currently empty.

methods.name: bind_search
methods.description: Binds a keydown event to search inputs to trigger search on Enter key.

methods.name: restore_filters_state
methods.description: Restores filter state from URL query parameters and updates UI checkboxes accordingly.

methods.name: get_items_with_filters
methods.description: Fetches filtered product HTML via AJAX call based on current filter state.
